facts: AvailabilityRuleSet and append-only indexed Weekly/Date/Override rules
AvailabilityCalendarRevision: immutable count/digest, IANA zone, timezone database version and optional SpecificationPin
operations: Availability.createRevision(calendar, timezone, weekly, exceptions?, overrides?, origin?) publishes a sealed immutable revision last
Availability.effectiveWindows(revision, from, until) returns bounded half-open UTC windows
invariants: At most 128 typed rules per revision and 31 days per whole-minute query; only weekly recurrence supported
Local-date exceptions replace weekly availability, including overnight carry; absolute overrides use highest unique overlapping priority
DST gaps contain no instants and both fold occurrences use wall-minute membership; timezone database mismatch fails closed
Revision pins rule count and canonical digest; later append-only rule rows cannot change the pinned indexed subset
Typed worker/machine/facility attachments; no capacity, reservation, appointment or generic subject pointer

acceptance.description: fixtures for worker, machine and facility availability
